Players Committee card image of [[The Falcon]] (original printing), game text: “May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Once per game, during your move phase, may make an additional move. While [Episode VII] Chewie, [Episode VII] Han, or Rey piloting maneuver = 6 and immune to attrition < 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/thefalcon.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
